title: LET'S TALK ABOUT JESUS
stanzas: Let's talk about Jesus the King of kings is He, The Lord of lords supreme thro' all eternity, The great I am the way, the Truth, The Life, The Door, Let's talk about Jesus more and more
O my loving brother, when the world's on fire, Don't you want God's bossom for to be your pillow, hide me over in the rock of ages Rock of ages, cleft for me
